0.content: The Turnfire first appeared in the era of the Grand Alliance and was used by Och-Kan to rule and to burn cities. Anyone hit by it feels a terrible burning from behind and is burned to a crisp if they turn to look. Yupanqui stole it, and the soldiers it was thrown at were turned to ash. As he left the city, he heard Och-Kan call from behind him, turned, and saw only a burned city and an army in ruins. The flames then burst from inside his eyes. The tribe says he burned for a hundred days before the fire fell into the Night Kingdom.

1.content: A heavy claymore that people claim the Firethief loved. They say even the flames of the Lord of Cinder Keep could not burn it away. Its two description pages tell Yupanqui's youth and old age, and in the second the old hero glances at the dusty sword when the Scarlet-Eyed Youth asks for his help.

2.content: Och-Kan, the half-human hero who followed Xbalanque, tricked the young Yupanqui into a mire. They remained comrades for a long time. When Och-Kan became tyrant, Yupanqui disliked his cruelty but did not rise against him for years, because he was Yupanqui's only surviving friend of old. In the end Yupanqui stole the Turnfire and used it on Och-Kan's army. See Och-Kan's own entry for the Sacred Lord's story.
